successor_rule: Only after first-round measured readout supports a genuinely changed mechanism; separate study ID and source, no threshold or seed sweeps.
scientific_rounds: Every study freezes exactly one round.

comparison.primary: All eleven original failing tasks must PASS for a complete repair.
comparison.regressions: All four previously passing control tasks must PASS; missing/blocked/error is not a pass.
comparison.partial: Report per-task gates and continuous metrics for every arm, including failures; do not combine best per-task recipes.
comparison.causal: One common committed source for all first-round arms; task architecture,data,initial prior,sampling,budget,cadence and RNG streams fixed.
